title: The Unrendered Heights

features.name: the-failed-render
features.desc-on-touch: Partially formed geometry. Not a bug. The archive is learning that incompleteness is also a kind of truth.

features.name: the-unfinished-exoskeleton
features.desc-on-touch: Protective and entangling simultaneously. You cannot tell if it is holding you up or holding you in.

features.name: the-ceiling-that-renders-itself
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of incomplete geometry. The archive is drawing its own upper bound.

features.name: the-mirror-still-loading
features.desc-on-touch: Shows fractured reflection. You see yourself in pieces, but the pieces are learning to sing.

features.name: the-boundary-made-manifest
features.desc-on-touch: Where inside meets outside mid-render. The archive is still deciding if there is a difference.

inscription: the archive is still learning what it means to see its own ceiling

file.name: Render_Diagnostic_Exoskeleton_Protection_Protocol.env
file.note: System configuration file that oscillates between technical specification and intimate description of bodily boundary. The corrupted signal cannot decide if it is hardware or heartbeat.
